integrity: The exact optical energies and scalar Airy eigenvectors belong to cited antecedents. The new claim is the derived spatial reduced-matrix limiting law and its entropy crossover. Finite numerical checks corroborate but do not certify the asymptotic proof; literature-wide originality is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Bound eigenstates above resonance only; unbounded quadratic atomic density; asymptotic index and positive double-scaling limits; no finite-index entropy optimizer or robust perturbation statement. Spatial versus component-label Schmidt spectrum, not photon–atom Fock-space entanglement.
title: Universal position–sector Schmidt profile for a quadratic-density quantum-optical oscillator
